>>264151293
>new causes of environmental harm, which no one today can even imagine, will emerge in the future
Perhaps this is the part that I don't understand about Ted the most. He argues that tech will end up causing environmental harm in the future that none of us today could even imagine (i.e. hundreds if not thousands of years in the future), and yet he proclaims that we should not bother ourselves in the matters of people in 500 to 1,000 years in the future and that we can't predict nor control the conditions then (Paragraph 212, Industrial Society). For me these thoughts seem contradictory with one another. If technology will cause environmental harm in 500 years, is it not then the problem of the people of that time as Ted argues of a possible reinvention of the industry?
